company_name: CSSC Offshore & Marine Engineering (Group) Company Limited (COMEC)
model: Owner-FCF DCF of consolidated shipbuilding operations plus sum-of-parts holdco bridge (engine route)

inputs.sbc_source: No share-based payment scheme disclosed in FY2025 annual report or any filing FY2017-Q1 FY2026 (Chinese SOE). SBC-zero market: rows kept explicit at 0%.
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,413,506,378 A+H shares (FY2025 AR balance sheet share capital RMB1 par; unchanged FY2017-Q1 FY2026). No dilutive securities. Held flat; no buybacks, no SBC.
inputs.fx_note: Model in CNY millions; per-share values converted to HKD at 1.1721 HKD per CNY (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-10T03:38Z; cross-check USDHKD 7.8472 / USDCNY 6.683 = 1.1742). Parity check vs A-share 600685.SS: RMB28.41 x 1.1721 = HK$33.30, more than double the H-share quote at inputs.price_as_of (H at a ~57% discount to A, an A/H premium typical for this name); the direction is confirmed because the A-share in HKD sits above, not below, the H price. refresh_price.py does not move this rate.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T07:57:22Z HKEX regular close (Yahoo chart API); 52-week range 10.9-18.0
inputs.wacc_rationale: CNY flows discounted at a CNY rate: China 10y CGB ~1.9% + beta ~1.2 x CNY ERP ~6.8% = ~10.1% cost of equity; group is net cash so WACC = CoE = 10.0%. Same rate in every scenario: cyclicality and SOE/governance risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not as a WACC premium (adaptations 7f).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities (RMB98.6m at Q1 FY2026, plus current portion inside non-current liabilities due within one year) are in total_debt; right-of-use depreciation sits inside D&A and no lease charge is deducted from EBITDA. Leases are immaterial (<0.5% of revenue).
inputs.nci_treatment: Consolidated operations are essentially Huangpu Wenchong (54.5371% owned). Flows are modelled at 100% and the 45.46% minority is deducted once in the equity bridge at its share of HW's value (base-case HW operating value + HW net cash), not at book and not again in the flows.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF for the consolidated shipbuilding operations + sum-of-parts holdco bridge. Routing: COMEC is an operating shipbuilder (Huangpu Wenchong) wrapped in a holding company that also owns a 41.02% equity-accounted stake in GSI (unlisted shipbuilder) and RMB6.7-8.4bn of China State Shipbuilding Corp Ltd (600150.SH) shares at FVOCI. The straddle rule applies: the operating business is valued on component flows; the GSI stake and the listed CSSC holding are valued separately in equity_bridge, and their income (equity-method income RMB785m, dividend income RMB56m, FY2025) is excluded from the flows so nothing is counted twice. EARNINGS QUALITY: FY2025 attributable NPAT RMB1,008m (+167%) is ~79% GSI equity income (RMB793m, GSI net profit +241% to RMB2.0bn on peak deliveries); core consolidated EBIT ex investment income, FV gains and net finance income was only ~RMB0.1bn after RMB0.3bn impairments, ~0.5-2% of revenue. FY2025 is treated as a peak year for GSI, and the GSI stake is valued at 0.8x carrying value, not on FY2025 earnings. FY0 owner FCF (RMB-967m = reported FCF -607m less interest income 359m) is a working-capital-driven trough (inventory +RMB2.6bn) and is not used as a base; the component build is. Interest income stripped because net cash (RMB9.1bn) far exceeds the FCF base. H1 FY2026 interim (Aug-2026) has not been extracted; Q1 FY2026 is the latest balance sheet.

equity_bridge.item: 41.02% of GSI (equity-accounted, unlisted) at 0.8x carrying value
equity_bridge.note: Q1 FY2026 long-term equity investments RMB6,482.5m (GSI RMB6,177m at Dec-25, FY2025 AR note V(xiii)). 0.8x because GSI's FY2025 RMB2.0bn profit is a peak-delivery year; FY2024 was RMB0.59bn, so mid-cycle ROE sits below the 10% cost of equity. Its equity income is excluded from the flows.

equity_bridge.item: China State Shipbuilding Corp Ltd (600150.SH) shares, re-marked, net of deferred tax
equity_bridge.note: FVOCI RMB7,233.9m at 31-Dec-25 (AR note V(xiv)) when 600150.SS closed RMB33.26; re-marked to RMB38.54 (2026-10-09) = RMB8,382m. Less 25% tax on the unrealised gain over cost (cost = 7,233.9 - 4,376.0 accumulated OCI gain = RMB2,858m): 0.25 x 5,524 = RMB1,381m. Dividend income (RMB54m) excluded from flows.

equity_bridge.item: Non-controlling interest: 45.46% of Huangpu Wenchong (cash share + base-case operating value share)
equity_bridge.note: HW net cash ~ consolidated net cash RMB9,062m less parent-company cash RMB1,373m (Dec-25 parent BS) = RMB7,690m; 45.46% = RMB3,496m. Plus 45.46% of the base-case operating EV (RMB4,547m) = RMB2,067m; total RMB5,563m. Book NCI is RMB3,532m (Q1 FY2026). Held at the base-case figure in all scenarios (single bridge).

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 4.8% vs revenue 5yr 12.1% and EPS 5yr -22.7% (FY2020 EPS inflated by a RMB3.7bn restructuring gain): divergence >30%. Revenue 5yr starts from the FY2020 cyclical trough (RMB11.6bn after GSI deconsolidation); FY2017 revenue was RMB22.9bn, so the 8-year revenue CAGR is about -1%.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF CAGRs are not meaningful: owner FCF (reported FCF less interest income; SBC zero) changes sign repeatedly (FY2020 -1,734, FY2021 +3,817, FY2022 +1,332, FY2023 +2,375, FY2024 -2,759, FY2025 -967) on shipbuilding milestone-payment timing.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 = FY2026 plan RMB21.218bn (+3.3%; not a commitment, Q1 +56% suggests upside). RMB60.6bn backlog (~3x revenue) carries FY2027-28; the FY2026 new-order target (RMB16.4bn, -30% vs FY2025 intake) and global orders -23-26% in 2025 imply a mid-cycle revenue dip in FY2029-31 before recovery.
base.margin_rationale: Core EBITDA ex investment income, FV gains and interest income: FY2025 ~4.3% before and ~2.8% after RMB0.3bn impairments. Higher-priced 2024-25 orders lift margin to 5% while they deliver, then mid-cycle 4%.
base.da_capex_rationale: FY2025 D&A RMB478m (2.3%, incl. ROU); capex 1.0-4.1% of revenue FY2017-25 (avg ~2.8% incl. Wenchong relocation years). Steady state capex ~D&A at 2.2%.
base.tax_rationale: FY2025 cash taxes paid RMB253m incl. VAT/surcharges; income tax RMB45m on ~RMB0.4bn of taxable profit ex equity income (~11%). HW high-tech 15% rate, ramping toward 18% blended.
base.wc_rationale: Negative working capital: contract liabilities RMB15.3bn + payables RMB9.5bn exceed inventory, prepayments, contract assets and receivables (~RMB19.3bn) by ~RMB5.4bn (-26% of revenue). Growth releases cash, contraction consumes it; 20% capture on the revenue change.

scenario_narratives.base: The RMB60.6bn backlog delivers FY2026-28 revenue of RMB21-23bn at margins lifted by 2024-25 pricing, then the 2025 slowdown in global ordering (and COMEC's own 30% lower FY2026 intake target) works through as a ~10% revenue dip in FY2029-31 before replacement demand from the ageing fleet restores 2-3% growth. Core margin settles at a 4% EBITDA mid-cycle; the defense/coast-guard book provides the floor. GSI is worth ~0.8x book and the CSSC Holdings stake is marked to market.
scenario_narratives.bull: Fleet renewal plus the alternative-fuel transition keep ordering elevated through the decade; the Honghu container-ship family moves COMEC into 5,300-9,200 TEU vessels, export mix (15% gross margin vs 6% domestic) keeps rising, and lean/cost engineering lifts core EBITDA to 6-6.5%. Revenue compounds to ~RMB30bn. Section 301 fees are delayed or diluted.
scenario_narratives.bear: 2025's 23-26% fall in global orders is the start of a classic down-cycle: Section 301 port fees and Western de-risking cut export intake, newbuild prices roll over against weak freight rates, and steel/labor inflation on fixed-price contracts compresses margins. Revenue falls ~30% from FY2027 to FY2030 (FY2017-20 saw -49%), core EBITDA drops to 1-1.5% and the negative-working-capital float unwinds, draining cash. Defense work prevents losses deepening further.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% default: shipbuilding is deeply cyclical, global ordering already fell 23-26% in 2025, management cut the FY2026 intake target 30%, and Section 301 fees are a live export headwind. Base 50%: backlog gives two to three years of visibility. Bull cut to 20% because it needs sustained ordering, mix gains and a margin step-change all at once, in a business whose core EBITDA margin has never been above about 5%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: COMEC is a holdco. Most of its value is net cash, a 41% stake in GSI and a listed CSSC Holdings stake; the consolidated shipbuilding operations (Huangpu Wenchong, 54.5% owned) earn thin core margins. FY2025's +167% profit came mostly from GSI's peak-delivery equity income, which is excluded from the flows and valued at 0.8x book instead of being capitalised. The operating DCF uses mid-cycle margins, and a negative-working-capital capture means a down-cycle drains the advance-payment float.
key_risks_to_valuation: Net cash of RMB9.1bn partly reflects RMB15.4bn of customer advances; a deep down-cycle unwinds it faster than the 20% capture models
GSI value depends on its peak FY2025 earnings holding; at FY2024 profit (RMB0.59bn) the 0.8x-book mark is generous
The CSSC Holdings (600150.SH) stake moves with A-share sentiment and is marked at the 2026-10-09 close; each 10% move is ~RMB0.6bn after tax (~HK$0.5/share)
SOE restructuring after the CSSC-CSIC merger could move GSI/HW assets at prices set by the parent
Holdco discount: the market applies one, the model does not

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 10.9-18.0. A-share 600685.SS and 600150.SS closes from the same API on 2026-10-09
data_sources.financials: 0317.HK FY2025 Annual Report (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement, notes V(xiii), V(xiv), V(liv), V(xxxiii)); Q1 FY2026 quarterly report (balance sheet 31-Mar-2026); 0317.HK_Metrics.csv FY2017-Q1 FY2026
